# FDGA049

> DO apply the `readonly` modifier to fields when possible.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.6 Other.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0044
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Check fields of non-readonly struct types for defensive copies.

## Options

```ini
dotnet_style_readonly_field = true
```

## From the book

Be careful when applying the `readonly` modifier to fields where the field type is a `struct`. If the struct isn’t declared as `readonly`, then property and method invocations might make local copies of the value and create a performance problem.
